dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: ♪ The sun is setting in his sky, time for him to say goodbye: Goodbye warm and goodbye light, hello wind and cold of night ♪ ...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: ♪ Time to rest now, sleepy-head, do not fear the night ahead. I will stay here by your side, stay until the dawn arrives ♪ ...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: Heh. Just singing my daughter's favorite nursery rhymes.

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: She used to beg me to sing them to her each day the moment I got home... But I was so focused on my work, I—I just ignored her...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: And then, I went to Liyue to give a performance... she suddenly fell ill and... she didn't make it. I didn't even get to see her before she died.

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: All she wanted was for her daddy to sing to her... Such a simple thing. Such a small thing. And I failed to give her even that...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: Oh my darling, don't worry, Daddy's here for you... Daddy will always be here for you...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: Sleep well, my child... Rest your weary head...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: Daddy will tell the wind to blow away the clouds, so the moon can see your lovely smile...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So! Seen anyone who looks a lot like me?

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: Hmm? A relative of yours, you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, nothing comes to mind. But I will keep my eyes out.

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: If anyone understands the pain of being separated from family, it's me...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: I wish you the best of luck, my friend.

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: Daddy will tell the wind to blow away the clouds, so the moon can see your lovely smile...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: Oh my darling, don't worry, Daddy's here for you... Daddy will always be here for you...
